# Selected proxy package notices

`texts/` preserves original upstream license, copyright, patent and attribution
text, named by SHA-256 to avoid duplicate copies. These files retain their original
terms; the platform's root license does not replace them. Source files containing
embedded notices are preserved in full as opaque text and are never installed or
executed by the platform.

The directory's Git attributes preserve these content-addressed bytes without
line-ending normalization or textual diff checks. Original spacing and heading
separators are retained exactly; their integrity is checked against the indexed
source hashes. This rule applies only to the notice blobs, not owned code or docs.

The machine-readable `index.json` maps the selected proxy's 71 packages and
59 source origins to notice files, exact source recipes and source archive hashes.
The six official nginx package notices remain in the separately retained,
image-bound support notice ZIP; their paths/hashes are also indexed. Keep these
companions together with any later authorized distribution.

Most upstream archives were checked against SHA-512 in the exact installed Alpine
recipe. Libyuv's exact recipe documents timestamp-varying Gitiles tarballs and
instead verifies sorted regular-file contents; that prescribed content checksum
matched. Its differing compressed checksum remains recorded. FreeType's referenced
FTL/GPL terms and all declared additional source archives are retained separately.

The Alpine base release package generates version/issue metadata. Public-key and
base-layout packages furnish recipes, declarations and checksummed source files
without standalone license files. Their actual attribution and declared licenses
are preserved; no synthetic permission statement is invented. Expat's upstream
2.10.0 notice is pinned to its resolved release commit and matches the retained
vendor change log. The exact Alpine packaging commit remains recorded, but its
mirror/canonical recipe endpoints were unavailable during collection. This does
not substitute a moving recipe or claim that unavailable packaging source was
reproduced.

This is preservation of furnished notices and source provenance, not a commercial
licensing or compatibility opinion. Publication and production deployment remain
outside the implementation authorization.
